goal: An authorized VII operator can see calls, WhatsApp contacts and Biz orders as one truthful drillable dashboard for any selected period, world and business.

intent_model.literal_request: Show every Maskyoo caller and whether that phone later created a Biz order, where, how many and for what value; provide a large today/month/custom dashboard split by world for calls, WhatsApp and Biz orders/revenue.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Adir can investigate every conversion claim from a top-line number down to the supplier evidence that produced it.
likely_rejections: Clicks are mislabeled as calls or messages
Businesses with zero local VII events disappear
Phone-level rows expose unnecessary personal data

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Every supported aggregate remains drillable to the minimized contact and order evidence available from BizOnline.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Require phone-level Maskyoo and WhatsApp rows, conversion state, order identity, amount and source-place context.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Large source totals and world breakdown for the selected period.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose period, world, source or business.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the exact contact rows and matched order evidence.
deferred_complexity: unsupported spa and future-world supplier conversions

natural_destination: Authenticated /admin/business-performance and its private server API.

facts.claim: BizOnline conversions returns contacts[] with source, time, phone, source-specific details, first later order, delay and later order IDs.
Matching is by same-site normalized phone, or form e-mail, to the first active later order; clicks are never matched.
facts.evidence: Supplier documentation, How contacts are matched.

facts.claim: The current adapter discards contacts[] and retains summary and clicks only.

assumptions.claim: The deployed server retains the BizOnline token and authorized admin session configuration.
assumptions.validation: Protected preview/server probes fail closed without exposing secrets.

in_scope: today, month and custom from/till filters
out_of_scope: spa conversion matching because the supplier contract does not expose it
production publication without a separate explicit instruction
invariants: Clicks never become completed calls, messages or orders
Biz order totals remain deduplicated according to supplier summary semantics
Supplier token never reaches the client
Unauthorized users cannot access any report
Existing VII analytics and local booking columns remain available

requirements.statement: Show period totals for Maskyoo contacts, WhatsApp contacts, converted contacts, distinct Biz orders and Biz revenue, with world breakdowns.
Show each supported contact with source evidence and whether a later same-site Biz order was found.
Support today, current month and custom inclusive from/till filtering plus world and business selection.
Include every public supported business in the selector even when its local VII activity is zero.
Protect personal rows and supplier credentials while preserving usable authorized drill-down.
Bound supplier load, show progress, allow stop/retry and preserve completed partial results.

acceptance_checks.setup: Conversion fixtures span sources, worlds and dates.
acceptance_checks.action: Choose today, month and custom ranges and world filters.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Cards and world/source breakdowns match validated supplier summaries and state the Israel timezone.

acceptance_checks.setup: A business has one converted and one unconverted Maskyoo contact.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Both phones, call states and durations appear; only the converted row contains order number, created time, amount, delay and later-order IDs.

acceptance_checks.setup: A supported catalog business has zero local analytics rows.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The business remains selectable with truthful zero local metrics and a loadable Biz conversion view.

acceptance_checks.action: Request summary and detailed contact modes.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Anonymous receives 403; authorized detail excludes token, e-mail and free-text message content.

acceptance_checks.setup: One supplier batch target fails after earlier targets succeeded.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Completed results and totals remain, the failed business is marked unavailable, and retry is possible without restarting successful targets.

acceptance_checks.setup: A running batch has multiple groups remaining.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No new group starts after stop; resume requests only unresolved targets and progress remains truthful.

acceptance_checks.setup: A period and business are selected.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The server remains authoritative, the same filters can be reconstructed and refreshed without duplicate outcome counting.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, tests and a frozen preview candidate are authorized. Production publication requires a separate explicit instruction.
